entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support zstd compression for oci/docker image layers #52244
  • `CP0002` False positives from `PackageValidationBaselineVersion` #52243
  • [NETSDKE2E]With .NET 11 SDK installed, "No .NET SDKs were found." is displayed in terminal output when running some dotnet command. #52237
  • Installing dotnet 10 SDK slows down dotnet 8 builds by over 100% #52236

Closed

  • Remove bundled FSharp.NET.Sdk #48818
  • Uninstalling RC1 leave sdk directory causing Dotnet to be in non-working state #9364
    Backlog
  • [wasm][coreclr] Support CoreCRL in WebAssembly SDK #51213
    11.0.1xx
  • [dotnet test] Extend --list-tests command to respect filters and provide machine‑readable output #52059
  • [NETSDKE2E]NET 11 TFM is unavailable with .NET 11.0.100-alpha.1.25617.103 SDK #52238
  • Better support for building against newer frameworks than SDK supports #51974

PullRequests

Created

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52242
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Retarget default templates to target net11.0 #52239
    Area-Common templates

Merged

  • [wasm] Switch between Mono and CoreCLR runtimes #52240
    Area-WasmSdk, 11.0.1xx
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52176
    Area-VMR
  • Add LoadPrunePackageDataFromNearestFramework parameter for building against newer TFMs #51978

Updated

  • Add trailing slash for -o Fixes #45682 #48640
    untriaged, Area-CLI
  • Fix interaction of "csc only after msbuild" optimization and implicit build files #52133
    Area-run-file
  • Publish SDK installer artifacts in CI pipeline #52233
  • Add Windows admin PATH management commands to dotnetup #52181
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #52074
  • Update the sdk target to net11.0 #52157
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #52022
  • Update target framework visibility conditions for VS version compatibility #52235
